calibrate_rule: Calibrate windows may be touched, held-out windows never. The calibrate windows were tuned on for the water and road layers; a plot or building model scores nothing in them, and no number in the plan is read from them. Held-out and reference windows (and the legend, title and scale) are still refused by export_tiles.py.
